title: Moderation
notAuthorized: This page is for moderators only.

flagged.mergeTargetPlaceholder: Find the target item by name
flagged.mergeConfirm: Move prices, aliases, reviews, and photos to the target product? This action cannot be undone.
flagged.mergeSuccess: The duplicate product was merged into “{{name}}”.

duplicates.hint: Pairs of items without a barcode in the same scope and category whose names look alike. These are not reports — nobody reports a duplicate, it just quietly splits one thing's prices into two buckets. Always check before merging: “tripe” and “goulash soup” are textually close but not the same product.
duplicates.renameSuccess: The item was renamed to “{{name}}”; the old name stays as an alias.

quarantinedFeedback.hint: Messages that FeedbackSpamDetector flagged as suspicious — the moderator sees WHY (spamReasons) and can send a false positive back to the regular queue.

accounts.hint: Paste the user ID (authorPublicUid) copied from the flagged records queue or the price list.
accounts.reasonPlaceholder: Why the account is being suspended/restored
